text:
maria: :rotating_light: Heads-up — we're seeing 5xx spikes on hosted generation for long-context requests (>2k tokens) in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Initial detection ~10:02 UTC. Impact is customer-facing: some long-form generation jobs returning 502/503. Posting here for visibility and coordination. status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1769998888
ryan: Investigating memory pressure on the inference pool. Kernel OOM events correlated with larger sequence lengths and KV cache growth. Reproducer: run generation with max_length 6000 on redwood-large and watch node mem climb.
karen: Noted multiple customer support tickets from two enterprise customers. Setting priority P1 for routing and mitigation.
sam: Rolling immediate mitigation: 1) Temporarily route long-context requests to redwood-large-q4 (quantized fallback) 2) Apply per-request context cap at 8k tokens for hosted plan for the next 30m 3) Increase memory slab limit on affected node group. Executing now.
ryan: Applied memslab bump on us-west-2 pool (nodes: infer-usw2-3a/3b). Also reverted a kernel prefetch param change from last night that increased memory fragmentation. Monitoring.
statusbot: Incident created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1769998888 — Investigating.
deploy-bot: Route update deployed: traffic split 80/20 redwood-large-q4 -> redwood-large for sessions with context >2048. (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-23-1145)
maria: Early telemetry: 5xx rate dropped ~65% in us-west-2, ~50% in eu-west-1 after routing change. Still seeing tail errors for very long sessions (>12k tokens).
ryan: Added a KV-cache TTL trim for sessions growing beyond 10k tokens to avoid runaway mem growth. Patch pushed to runtime (hot patch). Logs: 
```
[2026-03-23T10:15:31Z] runtime: kv_trim applied session=abc123 tokens_trimmed=2500
[2026-03-23T10:16:04Z] runtime: oom_guard triggered, prevented OOM, reclaimed=1.2GB
```
karen: Support playbook: notify affected customers flagged in PagerDuty incidents, offer temporary dedicated pool if they have strict SLAs. Inform sales and AMs.
sam: Customer impact summary for comms: "Some hosted generation requests with extremely long contexts may fail intermittently. We have implemented routing to a quantized fallback and memory mitigations; most customers are seeing successful requests. We're continuing to monitor." Approving this for status page update.
maria: Next update in 20 minutes or on significant change. If you see new 5xx patterns, drop logs here and tag me. cc @karen @ryan @sam
ryan: Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/infra/mem-pressure?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2 — added temporary alert threshold lowered to catch regressions.
statusbot: Update posted to status page: "Mitigations in place, routing to fallback model and memory guard applied. Monitoring."
karen: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to follow up with root cause postmortem (owner: ryan) 2) SRE to verify autoscaler behavior for long sessions (owner: sam) 3) CS to reach out to impacted customers with remediation steps (owner: karen)
sam: Will run a job to replay a set of customer long-context prompts against quantized fallback to validate quality drop. Results due +45m.
maria: Thanks team. If mitigations hold, we'll transition incident from "investigating" -> "monitoring" in status page. If anything changes, escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
